title: Abbott, Dexcom grapple with diabetes coverage ahead of planned Medicare expansion

title: AdvaMed Chair Mick Farrell shares his top priorities, challenges for the medtech industry

summary: Abbott has started a pivotal clinical trial of its investigational Cephea mitral valve system, the company said Thursday. The device, which Abbott acquired in its 2019 takeover of Cephea Valve Technologies, replaces the diseased mitral valve to restore normal blood flow through the heart. Cephea performs the same function as Abbott’s Tendyne but is delivered through a vein in the leg, rather than via a small incision in the chest.
title: Abbott starts pivotal trial for mitral valve replacement device

title: Labcorp, Quest urge RESULTS Act passage as lab payment cuts loom

summary: CEO Kevin Lobo said the slowdown in hip and knee procedures is tied to broader economic concerns. The outgoing CEO also detailed the company’s decision to partner with CMR Surgical.
title: Stryker lowers 2026 guidance after slowdown in hip, knee procedures

summary: The Food and Drug Administration has published an early alert about Medline brand beds linked to two deaths and 16 serious injuries. In an alert published Thursday, the FDA communicated Medline’s plans to discontinue the beds and associated products and exit the market. Medline contacted customers about the plans on Oct. 14 and issued an updated notice with modified recommendations for users on Oct. 24.
title: FDA posts alert about Medline beds linked to 2 deaths

summary: Albert White is stepping down as president and CEO of Cooper Companies effective immediately, the company said Tuesday. Walter Rosebrough Jr. will assume direct oversight of day-to-day operations until a permanent CEO is appointed. Cooper has elected Rosebrough, an independent director on its board, as executive chair. The changes come weeks after an activist investor called for the contact lens and fertility company to immediately start an external search for a new CEO and appoint a new board chair.
title: Cooper Companies CEO steps down after activist investor pressure

title: 3 highlights from EY’s report on 2026 medtech trends

summary: Abbott said Wednesday it received Food and Drug Administration approval for a transcatheter device designed to close a small gap that can develop between the heart tissue and a new valve after replacement surgery, causing blood to leak. Such paravalvular leaks occur in 7% to 17% of mitral valve replacements and 5% to 10% of aortic valve replacements, the company said. The Amplatzer Paraclose PVL Occluder is the first minimally invasive device approved in the U.S. to close paravalvular leaks around surgical replacement heart valves and offers an alternative to additional open-heart surgery for addressing the problem.
title: Abbott grows cardiac portfolio with Amplatzer approval for valve leaks

summary: The medical device company’s stock dropped when the market opened Wednesday after it slashed sales and earnings forecasts once again.
title: Boston Scientific cuts 2026 guidance for third time this year
